data.name: Jacquelyn
data.long_meaning: Jacquelyn is a name of French and English origin. It is derived from the Norman name Jacquet, meaning 'supplanter, or one who displaces'. In its Greek and Latin forms, Jacquelyn is associated with the goddesses Athena and Minerva, symbols of wisdom, warfare, and strategic planning. In the Christian tradition, Jacquelyn represents the triumph of faith over adversity.
